zh-CN.title: 自然与自然而然
zh-CN.shortSummary: “自然”在道家文本中首先指事物自身如此，不宜直接等同于现代的自然环境概念。
curatorialDescription: 概念页将章句、注本和现代解释分层，避免以单一译词覆盖历史语义。
zh-CN.researchNote: 需要补充《道德经》版本异文及唐代注本对“自然”的具体解释。
zh-CN.timeLabel: 比较概念；隋唐注释重点

en.title: Naturalness and self-so
en.shortSummary: In early Daoist texts, ziran first concerns being so of itself and should not be equated directly with the modern category of nature.
curatorialDescription: The concept layer separates passages, commentaries and modern interpretations so that one translation does not erase historical meanings.
en.researchNote: Variants of the Daodejing and Tang commentaries on ziran still need to be added.

displayDate.zh-CN: 比较概念；隋唐注释重点

zh-CN.title: 经典注疏
zh-CN.shortSummary: 注疏把经典、历代解释、校勘与教育实践组织成可传递的知识结构。
curatorialDescription: 概念不把“儒家经典”看作静态书目，而关注文本如何经由编纂和教学获得制度效力。
zh-CN.researchNote: 后续需按具体经典、版本、注家与官学使用场景拆分。

en.title: Classical commentary
en.shortSummary: Commentary organizes classics, inherited interpretation, textual criticism and teaching into transmissible knowledge structures.
curatorialDescription: The concept treats classical learning as an editorial and educational practice rather than a static list of books.
en.researchNote: Future records must separate individual classics, editions, commentators and institutional uses.

zh-CN.title: 求法与传译
zh-CN.shortSummary: 求法旅程只有进入译经、目录、讲学与机构协作后，才成为持续的知识传播。
curatorialDescription: 该概念把传奇旅行拆成路线证据、文本版本、语言劳动和城市制度四个层面。
zh-CN.researchNote: 不同人物路线、停留点和译经项目需分别核定，不以一条标准丝路替代。

en.title: Pilgrimage and transmission
en.shortSummary: Pilgrimage became durable knowledge transmission through translation, cataloguing, teaching and institutional collaboration.
curatorialDescription: The concept separates legendary travel into route evidence, text versions, language labour and urban institutions.
en.researchNote: Itineraries, stops and translation projects must be verified per figure rather than collapsed into one standard Silk Road.
